label: Audio
when: an audio file from the media library: a recording, a podcast episode, a song
rules: Use only an audio file from "The site's media library" (an "audio" line): its exact address as "src" in the HTML and its ID as "id" in the comment, like {"id":2481}. The comment holds only "id"; controls, src and the caption are HTML. Keep "controls"; no autoplay or loop. A caption is the figcaption after the audio and says what it is. If no audio file is in the list, write no audio block.
